## Passports

The passport is issued by the consulate. You must apply in person at the consulate. The passport photo must be recent. Bring the old passport to the appointment. Passport processing takes several weeks. Tomatoes need a lot of sun. Water the garden early in the morning. Compost improves the soil structure. Weeds compete with vegetables for water. Mulch keeps the soil moist. The consular fee is paid in euros. Fees are paid by card or bank transfer. Payment receipts must be kept. The fee depends on the urgency. Refunds of the fee are not possible.
